name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2506: v2504 added undeclared and unrecorded assertions so a fourth census source could not be added without being declared. A cold review found they compare KEYS only, so a source that contributes names and records nothing is invisible to both - confirmed by construction, both pass while the pool carries a name no recorded source accounts for. The sources record their sets now and the pool must equal the union of what the declared sources supplied. Also refuted its claim that the if-names guard is a no-op, with the interpreter.
